title: Why Does This Dot VANISH? (Find Your Blind Spot) 👁️
description:
Close your left eye, stare at the X with your right eye, and slowly bring your phone closer. At about 15 to 20 cm the red dot vanishes. Every eye has a blind spot: the patch at the back of the eye where the cable to your brain (the optic nerve) plugs in has no light sensors at all, so light that lands there is seen by nobody. You never notice the hole, because your brain paints over it with whatever is around it. Did it vanish?

An octopus's eye is wired from behind, so the cable never has to come through the wall: no blind spot at all.
